name: GM - Romulus Propulsion Systems, Romulus MI

fieldNotes.site: GM Romulus Propulsion Systems, 36880 Ecorse Rd, Romulus (Wayne County) MI 48174 - opened 1976, ~1.4M sq ft. Produces the HFV6 (3.6L) V6 engine and the GM 10-speed (10L) automatic transmission for Chevrolet/Buick/GMC/Cadillac vehicles (Blazer, XT5/XT6, CT5; Escalade, Tahoe, Yukon, Silverado/Sierra). UAW Local 163. Roster/web geocode (42.2521,-83.4018) is the Ecorse Rd address point; refined center to the main plant building cluster at ~42.2552,-83.4008. Positively identified via GM facility pages and matching satellite footprint.
fieldNotes.layout: One massive continuous plant building (~1.4M sq ft) oriented roughly square to N-S, set on a large ~180-acre parcel. Employee parking fronts Ecorse Rd on the south and Vining Rd on the west. Freight operations are concentrated on the NORTH and NORTHEAST faces: a dock bank along the north wall with trailers backed in, plus a large NE trailer/laydown yard (parked trailers + stacked returnable-container/steel racks) and a second trailer row mid-east. A powerhouse/utility complex with tanks and two water-retention ponds occupies the north of the parcel. A heavily wooded buffer and undeveloped land sit on the SE. The two large white logistics warehouses immediately west across Vining Rd are SEPARATE (off-property) buildings, not counted here.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Marked true. Freight enters via an east/NE perimeter access road that loops from Ecorse Rd (driveway at ~42.2522,-83.3982) up to the NE freight yard. The gate itself sits deep inside the parcel behind a thick tree buffer and is not resolvable from public Street View (2025-09 panos show only the wooded setback). A secured GM powertrain plant of this scale operates a controlled truck gate; truckGateCount estimated 1 primary freight gate (flagged uncertain - employee entrances off Ecorse/Vining are separate).
fieldNotes.guardShack: Marked true at medium confidence - a fenced ~1.4M sq ft GM propulsion plant conventionally runs a staffed gatehouse at its controlled freight entry. A booth structure could not be positively resolved in overhead imagery (a small blue-roofed structure on the east perimeter road near 42.2548,-83.3968 is a candidate). Flagged uncertain; remoteGs false as a consequence.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Estimated 10-25 (count ~24). A clear dock bank with trailers backed in is visible along the north building face; additional dock/trailer activity on the NE. Exact count partly obscured by roof overhang - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Banded 25-50. The NE freight yard holds an extensive set of parked drop trailers (one long row of ~20+ angled/backed trailers plus a second mid-east row), amid a material laydown area. trailersVisible ~40 across captured imagery; capacity ~70. dropYard true.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Marked true (medium confidence) - dock/trailer activity is present on physically separate areas (north dock bank vs NE trailer yard / east laydown). Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Marked false (uncertain) - no clear dedicated pre-gate truck staging apron outside the gate on the public road; the freight drive runs straight in from Ecorse Rd. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Marked true - the long internal east perimeter road and large paved NE yard provide ample post-gate queue/holding room between the gate and the docks. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: Marked true. A rail line (double-track mainline/siding with parked boxcars/autoracks observed) runs along the east property edge. A rail spur appears to serve the parcel; rail historically served this site (originally GM Detroit Diesel Allison). Counted railServed true.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Marked false - the plant is one continuous interconnected building. buildingCount 2 accounts for the main plant plus the detached north powerhouse/utility building. The adjacent west warehouses are off-property and excluded.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Romulus is within the dense Detroit metro / Detroit Metro Airport (DTW) industrial corridor, ringed by continuous industrial and residential development - Urban.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~180 acres estimated from the traced perimeter (parcel from Vining Rd west to the rail line east, Ecorse Rd south to the north ponds/utility area), excluding the off-property west warehouses and trimming the SE undeveloped wooded triangle.
